main_text.l: qualicunque opella juvarem; tandem ho-
ris succisius cœpi Systema illud Meta-
physicum paulo accuratius recognoscere,
& ad limam revocare, ac quantum in-
genii mei tenuitas passa est, expolire, expo-
litumque prælo subiicere.
Cogitanti autem mihi, cui has libro-
rum meorum primitias offerrem & con-
secrarem, nemo ex omnibus, præter tuam,
inclyte Comes, Generositatem, occurre-
bat, qui hanc prærogativam suo quodam
iure sibi vendicaret. Tu enim Scholæ
Steinfurtensis, in qua hic ingenii mei
fœtus natus fuit, primus es Fundator: Tu
eiusdem summus nutritius & patronus:
Tu primus me ex peregrinis locis ad Phi-
losophiæ professionem in illustri tua Scho-
la obeundum vocasti; & ab eo tempore
præcipuus semper studiorum meorum fau-
tor fuisti: Tu denique primus typogra-
phiæ Steinfurtensis autor & institutor ex-
titisti. Tuæ igitur illustri Generositati me-

page.notes: The mark at the top right corner ("E") is a gathering or signature mark, not a heading, and is left out. The foot mark ")(" is a gathering signature. The text ends mid-word at "me-" and continues on the next page. No catchword is printed. Spelling "prærogatiuam" is printed as such and has been normalised to "prærogativam" under the u/v rule. No illegible words.
